name: lakehousebox
description: LakehouseBox for agents: the read-only LakehouseBox MCP connector plus skills that teach the service - connecting through the lhbox CLI, MCP or plain DuckDB, reading public catalogs with no account, and reading or hosting Portolan geospatial catalogs.

interface.shortDescription: Shared Iceberg tables for your agents, run in Europe
interface.longDescription: LakehouseBox keeps analytical data as Apache Iceberg tables, operated in Germany. This plugin connects the read-only LakehouseBox MCP server (find tables, see how fresh they are, run read-only SQL, read files) and adds skills: how to connect with the lhbox CLI or DuckDB, how to read anyone's public catalog with no account, and how to read or host Portolan geospatial catalogs.
defaultPrompt: What tables can I read in LakehouseBox, and how fresh are they?
Open the public catalog commons/pubdata and show me what is in it.
How many trees are within 100 m of Puerta del Sol in the public Portolan catalog portolan/madrid?
